title: Final Energy for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct threshold energy of 46 GeV for the colliding beam facility.

title: Final Energy for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate the required energy of the e+ beam as approximately 8.30 x 10^6 GeV for the fixed target facility.

title: Energy of Z^0
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the energy of the Z^0 in the laboratory frame as E_{e^+}.

title: Velocity of Z^0
description: Important Criteria: The student must express the velocity of the Z^0 as (1 - (2m_e^2/M_Z^2))c.

title: Max Energy of Muons
description: Important Criteria: The student should determine the maximum energy of the decay muons as E_{e^+}.

title: Common Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect application of conservation laws or miscalculating the invariant mass.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all energies are expressed in consistent units, particularly GeV.
